item.text: The repository has a local `predicate` parser dependency that supports function and variable callbacks. I’ll use it to build typed expression nodes, then update the trait and PAM call sites to validate variables throughout nested expressions.

The first test run found that existing tests construct legacy `Expression` values directly and compare matcher types. I’m preserving those compatibility paths while keeping the new AST for nested evaluation.

package parse

import (
 \"reflect\"
 \"strings\"
 \"testing\"

 \"github.com/gravitational/trace\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestNestedExpressionsAndValidation(t *testing.T) {
 expr,err:=NewExpression("'`pre-{{regexp.replace(email.local(external.email), "''^([''^+]+).*$", "$1")}}-post`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 got,err:=expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"email":{"alice+tag@example.com","bob@example.com"}},func(namespace,name string)error{
  require.Equal(t,"external",namespace);require.Equal(t,"email",name);return nil
 })
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Equal(t,[]string{"pre-alice-post","pre-bob-post"},got)

 expr,err=NewExpression(`{{regexp.replace("abc", "b", "X")}}`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 got,err=expr.Interpolate(nil)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Equal(t,[]string{"aXc"},got)

 expr,err=NewExpression(`{{regexp.replace(external.x, "''^a", "")}}`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 _,err=expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"x":{"zzz"}})
 require.True(t,trace.IsNotFound(err))

 expr,err=NewExpression(`{{email.local(internal.logins)}}`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 _,err=expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"logins":{"a@example.com"}},func(namespace,name string)error{return trace.BadParameter("disallowed %s",namespace)})
 require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err))
}

func TestASTInvalidExpressions(t *testing.T) {
 cases:=[]string{
  `{{internal}}`, `{{internal.foo.bar}}`, `{{internal.foo["bar"]}}`,
  `{{other.foo}}`, `{{"asdf"}}`, `{{123}}`,
  `{{email.local(internal.foo, internal.bar)}}`,
  `{{regexp.replace(internal.foo, internal.bar, "x")}}`,
  `{{regexp.replace(internal.foo, "x", internal.bar)}}`,
  `{{regexp.replace(regexp.match("x"), "x", "y")}}`,
  `{{regexp.match("x")}}`, `{{regexp.match(internal.foo)}}`,
  `x{{external.foo`, `{{external.foo}} {{internal.bar}}`,
 }
 for _,input:=range cases {t.Run(input,func(t *testing.T){_,err:=NewExpression(input);require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err),"%v",err)})}
}

func TestASTMatcherAndDepth(t *testing.T) {
 m,err:=NewMatcher(`pre-{{regexp.not_match("''^bad$")}}-post`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.True(t,m.Match("pre-good-post"))
 require.False(t,m.Match("pre-bad-post"))
 require.False(t,m.Match("pre-good-other"))
 m,err=NewMatcher("foo*bar")
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.True(t,m.Match("foo123bar"))
 require.False(t,m.Match("prefixfoo123bar"))
 _,err=NewMatcher(`{{external.foo}}`)
 require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err))
 _,err=NewMatcher(`{{regexp.match(external.foo)}}`)
 require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err))
 _,err=NewExpression("{{"+strings.Repeat("email.local(",maxExpressionDepth+1)+"external.foo"+strings.Repeat(")",maxExpressionDepth+1)+"}}")
 require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err))
 e,err:=parse(`regexp.match("x")`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Equal(t,reflect.Bool,e.Kind())
}
EOF
